Pride and Prejudice Book Jacket Design

Read project overview

A personal book jacket design for Jane Austen’s Pride and Prejudice, drawing on late nineteenth-century book design with ornamental margins and florals. The symmetrical composition features Fitzwilliam Darcy and Elizabeth Bennet facing opposite directions, yet intertwined. Each element was designed and drawn by hand in Adobe Illustrator.
